boundary: All model results are hosted NVIDIA behavior. Nemotron-Mini-4B is direct generic-4B evidence, not Qwen3-4B, not full-model Clay adaptation and not local-device evidence. Embeddings are retrieval/semantic-geometry evidence only.

experiments.question: Does deterministic operation-specific compilation improve basis-validity decisions on a real 4B reader?
experiments.interpretation: Strong direct generic-4B support for deterministic-before-generative COVE/CBCC projection. One compiled error remains, so the model is still not an authority oracle.

experiments.question: How do raw intent, typed canonical intent and compact model-like symbols behave on an actual untrained 4B reader?

compact.content: D / Q only for a 16-item task

experiments.interpretation: On this actual 4B, typed L1 slightly improves exact policy decisions but is much more token-expensive; aggressive compact symbols collapse the output contract. Canonical semantics and model-native compact representation are distinct optimization/training problems.

experiments.question: Does a relevance prior alter a 4B reader under matched visible facts, and does shuffled prior provide a necessary negative control?

v1.note: All three arms returned only question labels.

neutral.reason: returned 9 values for 8 questions; first two match gold but output then drifts

truthful.reason: returned intermediate fact-chain values and hit max token length instead of 8 answers

experiments.interpretation: The prior is behaviorally influential, but this protocol does not establish beneficial truthful-field effect because neutral/truthful output contracts failed. The shuffled arm catastrophically steers answers despite authoritative facts remaining present. ClayGraph G1d benefit remains OPEN; provenance, strength calibration and shuffled/no-field controls become more important.

experiments.question: Can embedding similarity safely stand in for directed relation identity or semantic class identity?
experiments.interpretation: Role reversal is more similar than same-role paraphrase in both constructed relation pairs. Semantic-class labels reduce similarity but remain highly similar. Dense similarity therefore cannot define canonical directed relation identity, role binding, authority or emergence recurrence.

experiments.question: Is NVIDIA hosted reranking currently executable with this credential through registered routes?
experiments.interpretation: Reranking remains registered but unavailable on the currently verified hosted route. Do not silently substitute embedding similarity for reranking.

experiments.question: Which NVIDIA capabilities/models are actually credential-visible and executable?
experiments.interpretation: Model catalog visibility is not equivalent to executable account entitlement; actual invocation receipts are required.
